concept: Pace Line — an electric-blue speed primary paired with a volt-lime accent, near-black ink, and crisp off-white backgrounds. Energetic, fast, and motivating for a Naperville running and footwear store, with signal-orange as a warm sprint secondary.
contrastNotes: WCAG-AA verified. ink #0B1220 on bg #F7FAFC = 17.86:1 (>=7). ink-soft #475569 on bg = 7.23:1 (>=4.5). white on primary #1A5BD6 = 5.98:1 (>=4.5). primary-dark #16489E on bg = 8.16:1 (>=4.5). accent #C2F500 on #000 = 16.35:1 (>=3, bright pop on dark heroes). surface-alt #E9EFF5 is a LIGHT tint of bg; ink on surface-alt = 16.16:1 (>=7) and ink-soft on surface-alt = 6.54:1, so dark text reads cleanly on painted sections.
